_comment: cobolget lock/import manifest for the AWS CardDemo test suite. cobolget's native lockfile name is modules-lock.json; this file is named tests/import.json per the project's AAP-mandated test plan but follows the cobolget lock schema. It pins the EXACT resolved GCBLUnit version so every checkout vendors byte-identical framework code (reproducibility guarantee for a financial-grade suite). Companion to tests/cobolget.json. The framework is also vendored directly as tests/cobol-unit/gcblunit.cbl; this lock is the authoritative provenance record of its version.
